limits: The candidate record documents the final artifact set rebuilt by the release gate at 2bd42cc and the earlier local rehearsal at 9b1bef5; rebuilding at the record head changes only record text, but the tag must be built at the final merged head and its hashes re-verified.
Windows results come from GitHub Actions, not a local Windows host; Linux was executed locally.
Firefox and Safari static-subresource behaviour (Sec-Fetch-Mode) remains unverified; only Chromium was exercised.
The local read API HEAD performs one read without consuming the 10-second refresh budget, and a bootstrap token is single-use; sessions expire without a restart command.

The legacy learn_assistant.core.prepare_submission still writes an unencrypted local preview JSON; after total-audit P1-4 it contains only file name/bytes/sha256 plus a relative preview name, with directory 0700 and file 0600, never a local absolute path. It never uploads or submits and is retained as a v0.1 compatibility boundary.
The wheel does not ship node_modules; gateway-backed capabilities report GATEWAY_EXITED until the documented npm ci step runs.
Real campus login, writes, payments, submissions and model image transfers remain unverified; engineering checks do not raise their evidence level.
